# Documentation

How documentation is written, built and checked.

| Rule | Level | Applies to | Verified |

## KB-DOC-001: Markdown passes the org lint configuration { #kb-doc-001 }

**MUST** · all · since 1.0

Every Markdown file passes markdownlint-cli2 with the org configuration.

*Verified by:*

- `markdownlint/all` (implemented): markdownlint-cli2 with the org config; the parameter names the rule
  (markdownlint/MD040)


## KB-DOC-002: The documentation site builds strictly { #kb-doc-002 }

**MUST** · driver, library, hal, tooling, docs, template · since 1.0

A repository with a documentation site builds it with `mkdocs --strict`: no broken internal link, no page left out of
the navigation.

*Verified by:*

- `mkdocs-strict` (implemented): the documentation site builds with mkdocs --strict (no broken internal link, every page
  in the nav)

*Explained in:* [standards/docs.md](../standards/docs.md)

## KB-DOC-003: No broken links on the built site { #kb-doc-003 }

**MUST** · driver, library, hal, tooling, docs, template · since 1.0

Every link on the built site resolves, internal and external.

*Verified by:*

- `link-check` (implemented): lychee finds no broken link on the built site


## KB-DOC-004: Every public API is documented and Doxygen is warning-free { #kb-doc-004 }

!!! note "Proposed"

    Warns until 2027-01-15, then fails CI. ci-tools' Doxyfile has WARN_AS_ERROR = NO today.

**MUST** · driver, library, hal, template · since 1.0 · enforced from 2027-01-15

Every public type, function and parameter in `inc/` has a Doxygen comment; Doxygen runs with `WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED =
YES` and `WARN_AS_ERROR = FAIL_ON_WARNINGS`.

*Verified by:*

- `doxygen-warnings` (planned): Doxygen with WARN_AS_ERROR = FAIL_ON_WARNINGS and WARN_IF_UNDOCUMENTED reports nothing

*Explained in:* [standards/docs.md](../standards/docs.md)
